{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the two channels
print(df['channel'].unique())

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
# But note: no QA orders found in prior check
filtered_df = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Filter out refunded orders
filtered_df = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
filtered_df['revenue_numeric'] = filtered_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
channel_revenue = channel_revenue.sort_values('revenue_numeric', ascending=False)

# Print results
channel_revenue"}
